causal_feature_law.directional_side_leader: LONG when bid_move_bps>0, mid_t>mid_t-L, and abs(bid_move_bps)/(abs(bid_move_bps)+abs(ask_move_bps))>=0.70; SHORT when ask_move_bps<0, mid_t<mid_t-L, and abs(ask_move_bps)/(abs(bid_move_bps)+abs(ask_move_bps))>=0.70; denominator must be >0
causal_feature_law.signal: directional side leader + spread state filter + spread_compression_units >= frozen threshold

execution_and_response.entry: fresh side-aware quote at t+1 second
execution_and_response.exit: fresh side-aware quote exactly holding_seconds after entry
execution_and_response.missing: entry or exit not fresh => right-censor; no delay search/interpolation/stale repair
execution_and_response.overlap: one open event per symbol x frozen cell
execution_and_response.signal_time: integer second t after all ticks timestamped <=t processed

governance.robust_survivor_next_step: freeze disjoint remaining-DEVELOPMENT confirmation plus commission/volume/margin/EUR200 gate

multiplicity.support_rule_predeclared: all cells family members; only support-eligible cells generate finite max-T statistics; others p=1

quote_state.ask: latest ASK tick at or before snapshot second
quote_state.bid: latest BID tick at or before snapshot second
quote_state.freshness: both sides age <=2000 ms and ask>=bid>0

robust_region_gate.adjacency: one step in lookback, compression threshold, or horizon
